outputs.block:0:text:0: Ava DuVernay’s timely and viscerally moving “14th” leads this year’s Critics Choice Documentary Awards nominations with six, including best documentary feature. Close behind with five nominations apiece are Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim’s examination of Elizabeth Holmes, “You Can See Everything”; Gabriela Osio Vanden and Jack Weisman’s polar bear migration story, “Nuisance Bear”; David Greaves’ archival portrait of Black cultural history, “Once Upon a Time in Harlem” and Pegah Ahangarani’s Iranian historical documentary, “Rehearsals for a Revolution.”
outputs.block:3:text:0: Telly Awards Adds Microseries Competition Track, With Dozens of New Categories (EXCLUSIVE)
outputs.block:6:text:0: Netflix led all distributors with 17 nominations, nearly double the nine earned by runner-up Neon.
